copy.tagline: 用 Chat SDK 接入 WhatsApp 官方消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要接入 WhatsApp 消息的应用。
copy.tagline_en: Add WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel via Chat SDK
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app that needs WhatsApp messaging.

howto.what: 它把 WhatsApp Cloud 适配器复制进 NanoClaw 的 src/channels/,在通道入口追加一行注册导入,安装固定版本的 @chat-adapter/whatsapp,再跑构建与注册测试,并提示你填入 Meta 的四项凭据。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 接入官方 Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API 通道时触发;装完若正在 /setup 流程中则回到该流程,否则运行 /manage-channels 把它接到某个 agent 组。

say.text: 把 WhatsApp Cloud 通道加到 NanoClaw
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册并跑构建与测试

say.text: 跑一下 whatsapp-cloud 的注册测试
say.note: 红色说明导入或依赖漂移,需重跑步骤

howto.what_en: It copies the WhatsApp Cloud adapter into src/channels/, appends the registration import to the channel barrel, installs @chat-adapter/whatsapp@4.29.0, runs the build and registration test, and prompts for the Meta credentials.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add the official Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel to NanoClaw. If mid /setup, return to that flow; otherwise run /manage-channels to wire it to an agent group.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp Cloud channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, runs build and test
